name: cc-pr-tracker
description: Watch GitHub PRs from a Claude Code session: merge state, review and required checks above the prompt, with alerts when they change

muteAll.title: Mute all PR alerts
muteAll.description: Watched PRs keep updating but never toast, flash, play a sound, post a cmux notification or tell Claude.

alertOn.title: Alert on
alertOn.description: Which changes alert: every change to a required check or the merge state, only checks failing and a PR becoming ready to merge, or only checks failing.

notifyClaude.title: Tell Claude about changes
notifyClaude.description: An alert also adds a note Claude reads on its next turn, with the failing checks' log links.

sound.title: Alert sound
sound.description: Play a macOS system sound on an alert.

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often each watched PR is checked, one GitHub GraphQL call per PR. 30 to 3600; a value outside is held to the nearer end.

autoWatch.title: Auto-watch PRs
autoWatch.description: Which PRs are watched without pasting them: any open PR linked in Claude's answer and the one `gh pr create` prints, only the latter, or none.

remember.title: Remember watched PRs
remember.description: Where the watch list is kept: with this session, so resuming it watches the same PRs and a new session starts empty, or with the project, so every new session in this directory watches them.
